**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is. Describe what you expected to happen, and what actually happened (if applicable).

**Installation Method**
Please specify how you installed the extension:
 - Through "Developer mode" at "chrome://extensions"
 - Through Tampermonkey/GreasyFork as a userscript

**Extension Version**
Please include the version of the extension you are using.

If the extension was installed through "Developer mode" at "chrome://extensions", you can find the version you are using by heading to "chrome://extensions" and finding the Trello Colors extension. The version will be listed to the right of the extension's name.

If the extension was installed through Tampermonkey/GreasyFork as a userscript, you can find the version you are using by heading to your Tampermonkey dashboard (click on the extension icon, then select the "Dashboard" option).

If you are not using the latest version of the extension, please update to the latest and check if your issue still persists.

**Browser**
Please include your browser and its version (e.g., "Chrome 136.0.7103.114", etc.).

**Language**
Please include the language you use on Trello.

**Steps To Reproduce**
Please include the steps to reproduce the issue (if applicable). Use the following format:
1. I clicked on...
2. The labels on the back of the card...
3. etc.

**Screenshots**
Please include screenshots demonstrating your issue.

Be sure to check the developer console for errors and include them here (if applicable).

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
